description: Uva Province Provincial Council - Notify the Uva Entrepreneur Development Program, Statute No. 02 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette content promulgates "Uva Entrepreneur Development Program of Provincial Council of Uva Province Statute No. 02 of 2017," which establishes a new legal framework and regulatory structure for entrepreneurship development in the Uva Province. It creates statutory instruments, defines administrative structures, and sets regulatory requirements for program implementation, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for new laws, acts, and regulatory frameworks.
